title: Standard customer email journey
description: A practical lifecycle sequence that keeps customers informed from their first visit through delivery, with marketing messages separated from order updates.

steps.subject: Welcome to Weluxo — find what fits your life
steps.body:
Hi there,

Thanks for joining Weluxo. We’re here to help you discover thoughtful products that fit your life. Start exploring and find something that feels like a great fit.

See you around,
The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Introduce the brand, set expectations and guide the customer back to the shop.

steps.subject: A few smart upgrades worth discovering
steps.body:
Hi there,

Still looking for the right fit? We pulled together a few thoughtful upgrades worth discovering. Take a look when you have a moment, and save anything that catches your eye.

The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Show a small, relevant selection instead of sending a generic product dump.

steps.trigger: Cart has items but checkout is not completed
steps.subject: Your Weluxo picks are waiting
steps.body:
Hi there,

You left a few favorites in your cart. They’re still waiting for you whenever you’re ready. If you need a hand, our support team is happy to help.

The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Bring the customer back to the saved cart with the product, price and support link clearly visible.

steps.subject: Order received — we’re getting it ready
steps.body:
Hi there,

Thanks for your order. We’ve received your payment and are getting everything ready. Your confirmation includes the items, total, delivery address, and estimated arrival.

We’ll keep you updated,
The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Confirm the order, payment, items, total, delivery address and estimated arrival.

steps.trigger: Order is packed or tracking number is created
steps.subject: Your Weluxo order is on the way
steps.body:
Hi there,

Good news — your Weluxo order is on the way. Use the tracking link below to follow its progress and see the latest delivery estimate.

The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Share the carrier, tracking number, tracking link and the current delivery estimate.

steps.trigger: Carrier reports the parcel is out for delivery
steps.subject: Your order is arriving today
steps.body:
Hi there,

Your Weluxo order is out for delivery today. Please make sure someone can receive it, and contact support if you need help with your delivery details.

The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Set a clear expectation for arrival and provide support guidance if the address needs attention.

steps.subject: Delivered — enjoy your Weluxo order
steps.body:
Hi there,

Your order has arrived. We hope it becomes a favorite. If you have a question about your product, our support team is here to help.

Enjoy,
The Weluxo team
steps.purpose: Confirm delivery, link to support and returns, and invite feedback only after the product has arrived.

guardrails: Stop browse and cart reminders as soon as an order is confirmed.
Always send order and delivery updates, even when marketing email is opted out.
Include a clear unsubscribe link in marketing messages.
Do not send more than one lifecycle email to the same customer in a 24-hour period.
